name: t0/greedy
why: Greedy, on BOTH arms, so the pair is single-variable. This is the profile the tier wants and rarely gets: it was measured rather than assumed, at the budget the run actually uses (32000), which is the mistake that hid Qwen3.8's and GLM's spirals when they were tuned at 8000. Six probes, one per category, greedy thinking at budget 32000: 0/6 capped, 0/6 no-answer, every one finish_reason=stop with a real answer -- hpy-001 5104 tok, hjs-001 31085, hts-001 21170, hsql-001 2627, hsh-001 6868, hgit-001 13397, at ~60 tok/s. Greedy thinking spirals on Qwen3.5, GLM 4.7 and Gemma 4 12B; it does not spiral here, so no temperature escape and no presence_penalty brake is needed and the arms differ in exactly one thing. Two cautions the numbers carry. The traces are LONG (8.5k-120k characters); hjs-001 stopped on its own at 31085 of 32000, within 915 tokens of the cap, so some hard-tier tasks will cap and the recorded cap count is the thing to read rather than a surprise. And on b3, whose reasoning floor is 8000 rather than 32000, a trace of this length will bind on many tasks -- b3's floor is kept at 8000 anyway because every other model on that suite was measured there and changing it would break the comparison, not improve it.

arm_switch.why: Probed, not assumed. On this GGUF build reasoning_effort=none genuinely suppresses reasoning (0 characters of reasoning_content, against 1397 at baseline), so the OFF arm is really off. Every chat_template_kwargs form -- enable_thinking true and false, thinking false -- returns output byte-identical to baseline, i.e. silently ignored. The graduated scale is inert too: reasoning_effort=low and =medium are byte-identical to sending nothing, so only 'none' is honoured and the ON arm sends nothing (the model's own default). That is the opposite of Qwen3.8, whose ON arm had to name an effort because its default was xhigh. Note this contradicts the repo's earlier shorthand that reasoning_effort is ignored on GGUF: that was measured on Qwen3.8's GGUF build. The knob's portability is per-model, not per-backend, which is why it is probed per model.
